author: mrbizarro
description: Phosphene is a free, open-source Mac app for making AI videos, pictures, speech and songs offline. Run LTX-2.5 and MiniMax H3 (Hailuo) locally on Apple Silicon. No cloud, no API key, no NVIDIA GPU. Works with Claude Code, Codex and any MCP agent.
name: phosphene

tools.name: phosphene_status
tools.title: Check Phosphene status
tools.description: Is Phosphene running on this Mac, where, Free or Pro, which engines are installed and what each can do (qualities, lengths), and what is rendering now. Call this first.

tools.name: phosphene_make_video
tools.title: Make video
tools.description: Queue a video clip (with its own sound) on this Mac's GPU. Engines: 'ltx' (default; faces, voices, dialogue) or 'h3' (Hailuo H3; motion, landscapes, if installed). A prompt works best as one paragraph: who, where, light, the action, the camera, and the sound. Optional start frame: a picture path on this Mac.

image.description: Absolute path of a start-frame picture (makes it image-to-video).

quality.description: LTX: quick | balanced (default) | standard | high | high_720p. H3: draft | fast_hd | standard | high (see phosphene_status).

seconds.description: Length. LTX: about 2-10 s (default 5). H3: 3, 5, 10 or 15.

seed.description: Fixed seed for a repeatable result; omit for random.

wait.description: Wait until it is finished and return the file paths (a video can take 2-20 minutes). Default false: return the job id at once and use phosphene_wait.

tools.name: phosphene_open_cut
tools.title: Open cut
tools.description: Hand a finished cut to a person: turn your edit (clips with in-points and film positions, the soundtrack, overlays, levels) into a film in Phosphene's Editor, saved and ready to edit by hand. Each clip plays from its `at` to the next clip's `at`; a slot slightly longer than the take is filled by slowing the clip (reported in notes). Files anywhere on this Mac are brought into the film's folder; the originals are not touched. Returns the film id and editor_url.

fps.description: Frame rate the cuts snap to (default 24).

in.description: Source second the clip starts at (default 0).

out.description: Optional source second it may not play past.

at.description: Film second it starts at (omit on every clip to lay them back to back).

length.description: Film seconds (the last clip, or clips without at).

mute.description: Drop this clip's own sound (e.g. a lip-sync shot whose voice is in the score).

clip_gain.description: Default clip sound level 0-1 (e.g. 0.9 under a score).

clip_fades.description: Sound fade in/out seconds on every clip edge, e.g. [0.04, 0.06].

tools.name: phosphene_make_image
tools.title: Make image
tools.description: Queue still images with the image engine chosen in Phosphene's settings.

seed.description: Fixed seed for a repeatable result; omit for random.

wait.description: Wait until it is finished and return the file paths (a video can take 2-20 minutes). Default false: return the job id at once and use phosphene_wait.

tools.name: phosphene_make_speech
tools.title: Make speech
tools.description: Text to speech (if the Speech pack is installed). Returns a WAV.

wait.description: Wait until it is finished and return the file paths (a video can take 2-20 minutes). Default false: return the job id at once and use phosphene_wait.

tools.name: phosphene_make_music
tools.title: Make music
tools.description: Queue a song (style + lyrics) or an instrumental (style only), if the music pack is installed.

seed.description: Fixed seed for a repeatable result; omit for random.

wait.description: Wait until it is finished and return the file paths (a video can take 2-20 minutes). Default false: return the job id at once and use phosphene_wait.

tools.name: phosphene_list_jobs
tools.title: List render jobs
tools.description: Running, queued and recent jobs, with status, progress and output paths.

tools.name: phosphene_wait
tools.title: Wait for a render
tools.description: Wait for a job to finish (up to timeout_sec, default 1500) and return its status and file paths. If it is still running at the timeout, call again.

tools.name: phosphene_fetch
tools.title: Fetch
tools.description: Copy a finished job's files into a folder (for example the project you are working in).

tools.name: phosphene_stop
tools.title: Stop the current render
tools.description: Stop the job that is rendering now (optionally only if it is job_id).
